description.content:
Welcome to the VidGrid [REST](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Representational_state_transfer) API!

You can use this API to create and manage resources on your VidGrid account. The API is meant to be used server-side and all requests should be made over SSL.

Code examples can be viewed in the area to the right, and you can switch the language of the examples with the tabs in the top right. Contact Support: Name: API Support Email: videoengineering@paylocity.com?subject=API Inquiry
